sloka: सिम्हनादाश्च शूराणाम् तदा शुश्रुविरे पथि ।हर्म्यवातायनस्थाभिर्भूषिताभिः समन्ततः ॥२-१६-३७॥
transliteration: simhanādāśca śūrāṇām tadā śuśruvire pathi ।harmyavātāyanasthābhirbhūṣitābhiḥ samantataḥ ॥2-16-37॥

translations.english: Rama, the subduer of enemies, proceeded while the wellattired women standing at the windows of their mansions showered heaps of flowers on him from every side.
